terms.meaning: signals the browser sends when the internet connection drops or comes back

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for connection banner
sections.what: Brings in the React state and effect tools, two connection icons and a cloud icon, and the class joining helper.
sections.why: The banner needs to watch the connection and show icons and colors.

sections.name: OfflineIndicator
sections.title: Connection banner that appears and hides
sections.what: Listens for the browser going offline or back online. When offline, shows a red banner saying Offline Mode is active. When the connection returns, shows a green banner for three seconds saying data is syncing. When online and not recently reconnected, it draws nothing.
sections.why: Tells the user when the app is working from saved data, so they know changes may not reach the server yet.
sections.watch_out: The banner only reports the browser's connection state, so it can say the app is online while the server is unreachable. The three second timer is not cleared if the connection changes again quickly, and the Syncing text does not confirm that any sync actually happens.

summary: A small floating message at the top of the screen that appears when the internet connection drops, and briefly shows a reconnected message when it returns.
purpose: Tells the patient the app is offline, and that data is syncing when the connection comes back.
why: Header says real-time connectivity feedback. The reason for the three-second message is not stated.
how: Listens for the browser's online and offline events. When offline, it shows a red message. When back online, it shows a green message for three seconds, then hides it. On first load it checks whether the browser is already offline.
inputs: The browser's online and offline events, and the browser's current online status.
outputs: A floating banner. It does not change any data.
risks: The three-second hide timer is not cancelled if the component is removed, so it can run after the component has left the page. The banner says Syncing Data, but this file does no syncing, so the sync must happen elsewhere.
debug: If the banner does not appear, check the browser's network status and that the component is on the page. If it sticks on screen, check that the online and offline listeners are being removed.
